query: with svt_lessons as (select s.name as series_name,c.title as chapter_title,c.display_order as chapter_order,l.id as lesson_id,l.title as lesson_title,l.display_order as lesson_order,coalesce(length(btrim(l.content)),0) as content_length,l.is_active from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id=l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id=c.subject_offering_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id=o.subject_id join public.levels lv on lv.id=o.level_id join public.series s on s.id=o.series_id where sub.name='Sciences de la Vie et de la Terre' and lv.name='Terminale' and s.name in ('A1','A2') and (c.title ilike '%nutriments%' or l.title ilike '%protéines%' or l.title ilike '%lignée humaine%') order by s.name,c.display_order,l.display_order), citation_balance as (select sub.name as subject_name,coalesce(ct.theme,'Sans notion') as notion,count(distinct c.id) as citation_count from public.subjects sub left join public.citations c on c.subject_id=sub.id left join public.citation_themes ct on ct.citation_id=c.id where sub.name in ('Français','Philosophie','Histoire-Géographie','Physique-Chimie') group by sub.name,coalesce(ct.theme,'Sans notion') order by sub.name,citation_count desc,notion) select 'svt_lessons' as audit_type,json_agg(svt_lessons) as result from svt_lessons union all select 'citation_balance' as audit_type,json_agg(citation_balance) as result from citation_balance limit 2;
